source_tiers.definition: Japan Academy first-party HTML/PDF/publication explicitly states Japan Academy Section I/II or subsection for the exact person.

Government, university, museum/archive, or recognized academic/professional society source explicitly states the exact person's Japan Academy division/subsection; it must clearly refer to Japan Academy, not the Science Council of Japan or another organization.
Publisher, newspaper, encyclopedia, personal site, blog, search-result snippet, or other non-institutional source. May discover leads but cannot by itself resolve section.

reject_rules: Do not infer Section I/II from degree marker, specialty, faculty affiliation, prize field, publication topic, or co-occurrence with known members.
Do not treat Science Council of Japan division labels as Japan Academy section evidence.
Do not accept a search-engine snippet without fetching and preserving the underlying source.
Do not accept a source that says only Japan Academy member without an explicit Japan Academy division/subsection.
Do not reinterpret absence from a roster or webpage as Section I, Section II, or non-membership.
